vectors.title: Offline topology and deterministic funding
vectors.applicability: Required within the selected draft profile; exceptions require a prospective versioned rule.
preconditions: Digest-locked admitted SUT and dependency closure
steps: Restore closed service topology and clean device snapshots.
Mine the declared regtest funding schedule and mature the funding outputs.
Onboard each local and remote wallet through the common lifecycle.
expected: Every component reports the pinned regtest chain identity.
Funding outpoints, maturity, ownership and amounts match the canonical initial-state manifest.
No undeclared external service is contacted.
blockers: Qualified mining and native onboarding adapters

vectors.title: Integrated ToDo lifecycle
vectors.applicability: Required within the selected draft profile; exceptions require a prospective versioned rule.
preconditions: Digest-locked admitted SUT and dependency closure
steps: Execute the ISI-4 ToDo create/list/reload/redeem sequence in the complete topology.

expected: Each required ISI-4 assertion passes in this declared integrated matrix cell.
The same accepted transaction is traceable across wallet, Arcade, processor, proof service, storage and overlay when applicable.

vectors.title: GlobalKVStore message with licensed image
vectors.applicability: Required within the selected draft profile; exceptions require a prospective versioned rule.
preconditions: Digest-locked admitted SUT and dependency closure
steps: Admit a pinned message-board web artifact and canonical image bytes.
Create an LCH asset and place its content through UHRP.
Publish its reference within the specified GlobalKVStore PushDrop payload.
Resolve the message from another wallet/device, acquire the declared rights with regtest payment, and retrieve/decrypt/render the image.
expected: Payload, namespace, owner, key and version match the frozen fixture.
Resolved image digest matches the original; rights and delivery evidence satisfy the pinned LCH profile.
A reload reconstructs the same message and valid content relationship from authoritative state.
blockers: Frozen board-record and LCH acquisition profiles with fixture keys

vectors.title: Processing states and bounded recovery
vectors.applicability: Required within the selected draft profile; exceptions require a prospective versioned rule.
